blocks.en: Twenty‑four cultures under six defined light conditions at once. Green light induces protectant production and red halts it.
blocks.text: Twenty‑four cultures under six defined light conditions at once. Green light induces protectant production and red halts it.
blocks.zh: 二十四份培養同時置於六種已定義的光照條件下。綠光誘導保護劑生產，紅光則使其停止。

blocks.en: It took three design‑build‑test‑learn cycles. In Prototype 2 we measured 40 LEDs one by one (green varied by 26%, red by 22%) and matched them in fours, within 0.4–1.8%. Matching did not separate the intensity tiers, so the low, mid and high levels are set by PWM in code. Prototype 3 enclosed the array; overnight on a shaker a post snapped and the white holder leaked light between wells.
blocks.text: It took three design‑build‑test‑learn cycles. In Prototype 2 we measured 40 LEDs one by one (green varied by 26%, red by 22%) and matched them in fours, within 0.4–1.8%. Matching did not separate the intensity tiers, so the low, mid and high levels are set by PWM in code. Prototype 3 enclosed the array; overnight on a shaker a post snapped and the white holder leaked light between wells.
blocks.zh: 這經過了三輪設計—製作—測試—學習（DBTL）循環。在原型 2 中，我們逐顆量測 40 顆 LED（綠光之間差了 26%，紅光差了 22%），再以四顆為一組配對，組內差異落在 0.4–1.8%。配對並沒有把強度層級分開，所以低、中、高三個強度是在程式中以 PWM 設定。原型 3 把陣列封閉起來；在搖床上過夜運行時，一根支柱斷裂，白色支架也讓光在孔與孔之間洩漏。

blocks.en: The first culture run, on 19 September 2026, grew in all six arms (3.1), but light leaked between wells, so it is not a light‑dose result. The fixes from that run are not yet re‑tested, and we have not yet run the intensity test the array was built for. Every reading here is in lux, which is weighted for human vision; it is not a biological light dose until it is converted to photon flux.

blocks.en: The LPA is a 24‑culture LED array we built to test how wavelength and light intensity affect our CcaS/CcaR optogenetic system in engineered Bacillus subtilis. We designed it around strain 168; it first ran on WB800, the protease‑deficient strain the project moved to in September (bioreactor, 2.2). Red and green LEDs give six light conditions, with four replicate cultures each.
blocks.text: The LPA is a 24‑culture LED array we built to test how wavelength and light intensity affect our CcaS/CcaR optogenetic system in engineered Bacillus subtilis. We designed it around strain 168; it first ran on WB800, the protease‑deficient strain the project moved to in September (bioreactor, 2.2). Red and green LEDs give six light conditions, with four replicate cultures each.
blocks.zh: LPA 是我們做的一座 24 份培養的 LED 陣列，用來測試波長與光強度如何影響我們在基因改造枯草桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）中的 CcaS/CcaR 光遺傳系統。我們是以菌株 168 為對象設計的；它第一次實際運行時用的是 WB800，也就是本計畫在 9 月改用的缺乏蛋白酶菌株（生物反應器，2.2）。紅光與綠光 LED 提供六種光照條件，每一種各有四份重複培養。

blocks.en: Three design–build–test–learn cycles made the LEDs more even, cut the light leaking between wells and moved intensity control into software (PWM). The final design is enclosed, and its light is set in code before each run.
blocks.text: Three design–build–test–learn cycles made the LEDs more even, cut the light leaking between wells and moved intensity control into software (PWM). The final design is enclosed, and its light is set in code before each run.
blocks.zh: 三輪設計—製作—測試—學習循環讓 LED 更均勻，減少了孔與孔之間的漏光，也把強度控制移進軟體（PWM）。最終設計是封閉的，光照在每次運行前於程式中設定。

blocks.en: The optogenetic system responds to light intensity and wavelength, so every well needs defined, even light. An Arduino sets the intensity by pulse‑width modulation, with one MOSFET per intensity tier, and a condition stays fixed for the whole run. The array, six columns of four with the MOSFET that drives each pair, is drawn in 4.2 Light Layout.
blocks.text: The optogenetic system responds to light intensity and wavelength, so every well needs defined, even light. An Arduino sets the intensity by pulse‑width modulation, with one MOSFET per intensity tier, and a condition stays fixed for the whole run. The array, six columns of four with the MOSFET that drives each pair, is drawn in 4.2 Light Layout.
blocks.zh: 光遺傳系統會對光強度與波長作出反應，所以每個孔都需要明確而均勻的光。Arduino 以脈寬調變（PWM）設定強度，每一個強度層級各用一顆 MOSFET，一種條件在整次運行中保持固定。這座陣列是六欄、每欄四顆，連同驅動每一對的 MOSFET，畫在 4.2 光照佈局。

blocks.en: We put a green and a red LED in each column so we could switch between them quickly and test the on/off control of protectant production directly. We calibrated nothing yet. First we wanted to know whether the idea works at all.
blocks.text: We put a green and a red LED in each column so we could switch between them quickly and test the on/off control of protectant production directly. We calibrated nothing yet. First we wanted to know whether the idea works at all.
blocks.zh: 我們在每一欄放一顆綠光與一顆紅光 LED，這樣就能在兩者之間快速切換，直接測試保護劑生產的開關控制。這時我們還沒有做任何校正。我們先想知道的是這個想法到底行不行。

blocks.en: Each column has a dual green/red LED. We printed wire‑management parts from the start, because even at this size the wiring gets messy fast, and ran the array straight from a breadboard.
blocks.text: Each column has a dual green/red LED. We printed wire‑management parts from the start, because even at this size the wiring gets messy fast, and ran the array straight from a breadboard.
blocks.zh: 每一欄都有一組綠／紅雙色 LED。我們一開始就列印了理線件，因為即使是這個尺寸，線路也很快就會亂掉；陣列則直接由麵包板驅動。

blocks.en: The red and green channels switched on and off when the code told them to. But the light output was uneven across wells, and because the green and red LEDs sat asymmetrically, the light was unbalanced from top to bottom.
blocks.text: The red and green channels switched on and off when the code told them to. But the light output was uneven across wells, and because the green and red LEDs sat asymmetrically, the light was unbalanced from top to bottom.
blocks.zh: 紅光與綠光通道都依程式的指令開關。但各孔之間的光輸出並不均勻，而且因為綠光與紅光 LED 的位置不對稱，光從上到下也不平衡。

blocks.en: The dual‑wavelength idea works, but one source of variation had to be fixed first.
blocks.text: The dual‑wavelength idea works, but one source of variation had to be fixed first.
blocks.zh: 雙波長的想法可行，但有一個變異來源必須先解決。

blocks.en: LEDs in different wells gave different intensities at the same setting, so the low, mid and high levels were not consistent across the array, and conditions could not be compared reliably.
blocks.text: LEDs in different wells gave different intensities at the same setting, so the low, mid and high levels were not consistent across the array, and conditions could not be compared reliably.

blocks.en: In Prototype 2 we worked on giving every well the same light. LEDs with very similar measured output were grouped into matched sets for each wavelength, and these sets became the low, mid and high columns.
blocks.text: In Prototype 2 we worked on giving every well the same light. LEDs with very similar measured output were grouped into matched sets for each wavelength, and these sets became the low, mid and high columns.
blocks.zh: 在原型 2，我們著手讓每個孔得到相同的光。量測輸出非常接近的 LED，按波長各自編成配對組，這些組就成了低、中、高三種強度的欄。

blocks.en: We drove each LED at 5 V and measured it on its own with a light meter, in a printed fixture that keeps the same distance and angle every time. Each LED got a tag with its row (A to D, downward) and column (1 to 5, across), so every LED can be traced back to its own reading. Then we rewired the array with the matched LEDs grouped into columns.
blocks.text: We drove each LED at 5 V and measured it on its own with a light meter, in a printed fixture that keeps the same distance and angle every time. Each LED got a tag with its row (A to D, downward) and column (1 to 5, across), so every LED can be traced back to its own reading. blocks.zh: 我們以 5 V 驅動每一顆 LED，用照度計單獨量測它，並把它放在一個列印治具裡，讓每一次的距離與角度都一樣。每一顆 LED 都貼上標籤，標出它的列（A 到 D，由上往下）與欄（1 到 5，由左往右），所以每一顆 LED 都能對回自己的讀值。接著我們重新配線，把配對好的 LED 依欄分組。

blocks.text: Tag Each LED was labeled so its measurement could be traced.
blocks.zh: 標籤 每一顆 LED 都貼上標籤，讓它的量測值可以追溯。

blocks.text: Rewire LEDs with similar outputs were grouped into matched columns.

blocks.en: Matching cut the variation inside each group a lot. Before sorting, the green LEDs varied by 26% and the red by 22%; after matching, the four LEDs in a group differed by only about 0.4–1.7% for green and 1.5–1.8% for red. But matching did not give three distinct intensity levels. The low, mid and high groups were still too close, especially for green. The green high group was also a little less even than the other green groups, because it was made from the LEDs left over after the first two.
blocks.text: Matching cut the variation inside each group a lot. Before sorting, the green LEDs varied by 26% and the red by 22%; after matching, the four LEDs in a group differed by only about 0.4–1.7% for green and 1.5–1.8% for red. But matching did not give three distinct intensity levels. The low, mid and high groups were still too close, especially for green. The green high group was also a little less even than the other green groups, because it was made from the LEDs left over after the first two.
blocks.zh: 配對把每一組內部的變異壓低了很多。分組之前，綠光 LED 之間差了 26%，紅光差了 22%；配對之後，同一組四顆 LED 的差異只有大約 0.4–1.7%（綠光）與 1.5–1.8%（紅光）。但配對並沒有做出三個明顯分開的強度層級。低、中、高三組仍然太接近，綠光尤其如此。綠光高強度組也比其他綠光組稍微不均勻一些，因為它是用前兩組挑完之後剩下的 LED 組成的。

blocks.en: So we use matching to make each column even, and set the low, mid and high levels with the PWM duty cycle instead of by picking LEDs.
blocks.text: So we use matching to make each column even, and set the low, mid and high levels with the PWM duty cycle instead of by picking LEDs.
blocks.zh: 所以我們用配對讓每一欄內部均勻，而低、中、高三個強度改用 PWM 工作週期設定，不再靠挑選 LED。

blocks.en: Prototype 2 still had practical problems for Prototype 3 to fix. The electronics were exposed, intensity was set by hand, and the tubes had no fixed position above the LEDs and no shield from room light.
blocks.text: Prototype 2 still had practical problems for Prototype 3 to fix. The electronics were exposed, intensity was set by hand, and the tubes had no fixed position above the LEDs and no shield from room light.

blocks.en: During the overnight shaker test, one of the printed posts on the bottom plate broke off, and several wires came loose and had to be resoldered. blocks.en: The three MOSFETs and all 48 LED leads meet on one 160 × 100 mm perf board, screwed to the base plate’s four stands under the LED holder. Each tier’s eight minus leads are twisted together with its MOSFET’s drain lead and soldered across three holes on one side of the board: low on the left, medium on top, high on the right. All 24 plus leads meet the same way on the bottom side, wired to 5 V, and the three sources share a joint wired to GND. Jumpers on the gates go to Arduino pins D9, D10 and D11.

blocks.en: The LPA is not a new idea. Lighting a plate of cultures from below, with control per well, is the Light Plate Apparatus design from the optogenetics literature1, and this LPA is named after it. We added the dual‑wavelength column layout, LEDs matched by measured output and an enclosure sized for our own tubes.
blocks.text: The LPA is not a new idea. Lighting a plate of cultures from below, with control per well, is the Light Plate Apparatus design from the optogenetics literature1, and this LPA is named after it. We added the dual‑wavelength column layout, LEDs matched by measured output and an enclosure sized for our own tubes.

blocks.en: The biology, the CcaS/CcaR green/red switch, also comes from the literature; Castillo‑Hair and colleagues characterized it in Bacillus subtilis2. This page reports light in lux and does not convert it to photon flux, so these tiers are not placed on that paper’s dose scale.
